caption:
It’s never too late to revitalise the environment, feel the fresh air and remind the essential. It’s never too late to recollect how it was started, what is our path and where do we go. It’s always good to keep you mind at the essential to keep your path moving forward.

It’s been 20 years since I have started my professional journey in the French restaurant Le Duck. I still remember that majestic smell of them kitchen when I came there for the first time - mixture of vegetables, shallots, garlic, herbs, cheese, tomatoes on the vine. I was standing with the closed eyes, sniffing and smiling… I understood that I had found the place which belongs to me and I belong to it, this is my home and my destiny - to make these products alive, to be honest with them and to bring their best on the plates, creating exceptional dishes for the people who value the nature and it’s creations.

Later I have gotten a lot of worth-living experience with different great teams from my first teacher Michelin star Chef Jerome Coustillas till the international teams in such brands like Ritz Carlton, Radisson Collection, Four Seasons, FIVE, working for connoisseurs of delicious natural food. 

I am Mika Tolkachev and I am the Executive Chef and Chef de Cuisine, and it’s always a good time to remind the essential and remember what we are living for.

And I warmly welcome you all here and hope we may enjoy our path together. 

#Liberté #Égalité #Gastronomie #mikacuisine
